description: Damage Assessment and Reconstruction Monitoring - Suburb and LGA Summary – North Queensland Flooding, 6 – 10 March 2018 is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Queensland Reconstruction Authority. Queensland Reconstruction Authority conducted Damage Assessment and Reconstruction Monitoring (DARMSys) audits of residences in the Cairns, Cassowary Coast, Hinchinbrook Shire, Townsville Council area following North Queensland Flooding, 6 – 10 March 2018. The event was a flood which occurred in North Queensland during 6 – 10 March 2018. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Queensland Reconstruction Authority. Its tags are Cairns, Cassowary Coast, Floods, Hinchinbrook Shire, Housing. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-06-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
